newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana acquires more Montres Cerruti stake.
newsitem.headline: Egana acquires more Montres Cerruti stake.

text.p: Watch and jewellery products maker and distributor Egana International (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it had acquired an additional 20 percent of Montres Cerruti 1881 S.A. from Christ Holdings GmbH for 231,805 marks.
Egana said in a statement the acquisition increased the company's holding of Montres Cerruti 1881 to a 85 percent stake.
Prior to the acquisition, Christ held 20 percent issued shares of Montres Cerruti 1881, it said, adding that the remaining 15 percent stake was held by two independent unrelated parties.

Montres Cerruti 1881 holds an exclusive licence to use the "CRR Cerruti 1881" and "CRR Nino Cerruti" trademarks for the design, manufacture and distribution of watches on a worldwide basis. The licence is valid until December 31, 2001 and is renewable for an additional five years on expiry, it said.
